title: Editorial
summary: Warm paper, high-contrast serif display, oxblood accent, slow page-turn pushes; a magazine spread in motion.
direction: A printed magazine come to life. Huge serif display type (Instrument Serif) set tight, italics for emphasis, small tracked sans labels. Warm paper, a single oxblood accent, hairline rules. Asymmetric layouts with generous margins. Motion is slow and literary: lines reveal from a mask, pages turn with a slow push. Camera barely moves. Note: warm paper + Instrument Serif + one oxblood accent with sparse frames is the "tasteful AI" look the user rejected as slop (BAR, fourth rejection). Use it only for a real publication, and make the frames dense: real spreads, photography, layered type. Fits: publishing, finance, craft, considered brands. Not for: hype or gaming. Score: piano, chamber strings or jazz trio. Keep the serif only if the subject is literary; choose the face for the brand.
